title: Update the engine in place instead of re-downloading it, and give the bump a skill
description: Two halves of the same gap. (1) USER-FACING: /engine/upgrade in routes/engine.js does fs.remove on the whole ComfyUI_windows_portable dir and re-downloads the ~1 GB portable 7z plus every custom node and python dep - for what is usually a few-MB core bump. The portable ships ComfyUI as a GIT CHECKOUT (proved 2026-08-06: the app engine sat at 32212244 = the pinned v0.29.2 sha, remote Comfy-Org/ComfyUI) and even bundles its own update/update.py, so a fetch + checkout of the pinned sha plus a pip install of the changed core packages is the same result in seconds. Reserve the full wipe for when it is actually needed - a DEPRECATED or removed custom node, a python/torch floor change in the portable itself, or a broken tree. (2) AGENT-FACING: there is no playbook or skill for bumping the APP engine. /mpi-bump-local-comfy covers only the standalone G:/ComfyUi bench; docs/versioning.md SS COMFY_VERSION is the only written guidance and it is two lines about keeping system_dependencies.json and node_lock.json in sync. The 0.29.2 -> 0.30.0 bump was done by hand under MPI-449 and the whole sequence should be captured. SCOPE SPLIT (MPI-468, 2026-08-07): this card owns the MECHANIC only - the in-place /engine/upgrade path and the repo-side bump SKILL. The engine-bump PLAYBOOK file and the smoke gate belong to MPI-467; the skill CALLS that playbook rather than restating it. Both are dispatched together under MPI-468.
acceptance: /engine/upgrade takes an in-place path by default: git fetch --tags + checkout the node_lock pinned sha, pip install only the core packages whose pins changed, restamp .mpi_engine_version
The full wipe-and-redownload still exists and is REACHED BY A DECISION, not by default - deprecated/removed custom node, a portable-level python or torch change, or a tree that fails a health check
Deprecation is DETECTED, not guessed: compare the installed custom_nodes set against node_lock.json and only force a wipe when a node was removed from the lock or fails to import
The in-place path never destroys a symlinked custom node (the dev machine symlinks custom_nodes/ComfyUI-MpiNodes to c:/AI/Mpi/ComfyUi-MpiNodes; the wipe replaces it with a plain clone)
A user on the previous engine version is upgraded end-to-end on a real machine and ends on the new version with every shipped class_type still registering
A skill exists for the repo-side bump and encodes the sequence proved on 0.29.2 -> 0.30.0
The skill's floor check is EMPIRICAL: collect every class_type used by comfy_workflows/*.json and assert all of them register on the target version before the pin is committed
The skill checks that the target version actually has a portable release asset - upstream tags can exist with no Comfy-Org portable build (v0.30.1 and v0.30.2 had none on 2026-08-06)
